1:1: The pinned SBLGNT text used by DGT does not include the words “Son of God” in Mark 1:1; DGT follows that Greek text rather than supplying the longer reading.
1:41: The pinned SBLGNT text reads ὀργισθεὶς (“moved with anger”) here. Many manuscripts instead have σπλαγχνισθείς (“moved with compassion”); DGT translates the pinned SBLGNT reading.
